title: How to Use ChatGPT to Write a Cover Letter (Is a ChatGPT Cover Letter Better?!)
description:
Want to use ChatGPT to write a cover letter? It's one of the BEST things you can outsource to AI in your job search—and it's easy to do. 

Here's how: 

1. Open up ChatGPT. For the prompt, you have a few options: 

– Write my cover letter for the [TITLE] role at [COMPANY] in a conversational tone, using my resume below as a reference. (Replace the title and company with options more relevant to your potential future role and company!)
– Write a cover letter with metrics for the following job description. Use my resume for reference, and keep it shorter than 400 words. 
– Write a cover letter for X role at X company and include the 5 most important keywords from the job description.

2.  Type “Shift” + “Enter” to create a new line. Paste your most recent resume, minus any personal contact information at the top. 

3. When you get your result, save it in a Google Doc or Word doc. 

 Note: You'll want to edit these after AI takes the first pass. The tech is there to help and support you, but we don't encourage using it as a substitute for doing the work entirely.
